input.summary: Limit the no-consent assignment carve-out to Customer, bar Kubient assignment to a Customer competitor, and confirm no termination right on Customer's change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] We keep our affiliate/successor assignment freedom but limit the no-consent carve-out to AP, so Kubient's assignments remain subject to our consent (which we will not unreasonably withhold) and can never be made to an AP competitor; we also confirm a change of control of AP gives Kubient no termination right.

ops.oldText: provided however, that either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
ops.newText: provided however, that Customer may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of Customer's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction, Kubient may not assign this Agreement to any competitor of Customer, and Customer's change of control shall not give Kubient any right to terminate this Agreement.
